title: WHAT IF YOU COULD SEE EVERYONE'S LIFESPAN? ⏳ (Animated Short Film)
description:
Pip woke up on a Tuesday morning expecting a normal day. But when he stepped onto the bustling street, glowing holographic numbers were floating above everyone's head. His barista had forty-eight years. An old man in the park had three months. Then, Pip looked at a stranger crossing the street. The red timer above him read: twelve seconds. Before Pip could speak, a delivery truck ran the red light.

The numbers were exact, unchangeable lifespans. Pip realized he was the only person alive who could see the cosmic countdown. Driven by conscience, he became an anonymous guardian angel. He yanked pedestrians out of traffic, called ambulances before heart attacks occurred, and saved dozens from freak accidents. But meddling with fate came with an invisible consequence.

Every time Pip cheated death for someone else, the universal ledger had to balance. When he looked in the bathroom mirror that night, his breath stopped. Floating above his own head was a flickering crimson timer. It read: seventy-two hours. Three days left. Saving strangers hadn't destroyed their deaths... it had subtracted their borrowed time directly from his own lifespan.

Desperate to survive, Pip uncovered a shadowy black market of secret lifespan trading. Ultra-wealthy elites with six hours left were offering billions to siphon decades from young, desperate volunteers. Pip faced a horrifying reality: to extend his own life, he would have to steal time from someone else, becoming the very predator he had fought against.

💬 THE ULTIMATE EXISTENTIAL DILEMMA:
═══════════════════════════════════════════
Pip stood at the ultimate crossroads of human existence:
👉 Option A: "KNOW YOUR EXACT DEATH DATE — Live with zero fear until your final second, with complete certainty."
👉 Option B: "LIVE IN COMPLETE UNCERTAINTY — Remain blind to your fate, living with the thrill and hope of mystery."

Drop your choice in the comments below! We read and heart every single comment. ❤️
